WelcomeLabel2: This will install [name/ver] on your computer.%n%nDuring installation, Python, the Python components and the fonts (about {#ComponentesMB} MB) will be downloaded from their official sites: an Internet connection is required.%n%nIt is recommended that you close AventyaPDF before continuing.
MenuConfianza: For the “AventyaPDF” submenu to appear in the Windows 11 right-click menu, Windows has to trust the AventyaPDF certificate.%n%nWindows will now ask for administrator permission (only this once on this computer).
MenuSinPermiso: Administrator permission wasn't granted.%n%nWithout it, the “AventyaPDF” right-click submenu will stay under “Show more options”. Ask again?%n%n(You can also do this later from AventyaPDF: Help › Repair the File Explorer context menu.)
MenuFallo: Couldn't add the “AventyaPDF” submenu to the Windows 11 main menu (it's still under “Show more options”). Details in:
CertQuitar: To remove the AventyaPDF right-click menu certificate from this computer, Windows will ask for administrator permission.
CertNoQuitado: The AventyaPDF certificate wasn't removed from the computer's “Trusted People” store (administrator permission wasn't granted).%n%nYou can remove it manually: “Manage computer certificates” (certlm.msc) › Trusted People › Certificates › “Aventya Asesoria Integral SL”.
DescripcionApp: PDF viewer and editor with digital signature and OCR
